Project-authored Arabic sign layouts and text. Noto Sans Arabic font: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see ../Fonts/Arabic/OFL.txt.
The *_Designed.png fascia and collection plaques are project artwork generated with the built-in image_gen tool on October 20, 2026; see DESIGNED_BRANDING.md for exact prompts. They do not embed a font file.
Atlas derivatives preserve the original artwork cells from WallGraphics; original attribution remains in WallGraphics/LICENSE.txt and the in-app credits. Text-bearing cells replaced with project-authored Arabic graphics.
